verdicts.reasoning: Every seed presents a word problem that requires setting up and solving (or evaluating a proposed solution to) a division equation.
The divisors in the word problems are exclusively 2, 3, 4, 5, and 10.
Seeds 11, 57, 64, 91, and 127 explicitly involve the Philippine Peso symbol (₱) and monetary values.
